content:
Written by John Edward Betancourt

Key Art for ‘Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena’ Courtesy of AMC Global Media.

It is quite the interesting time we live in, when it comes to our beliefs in science. Because let’s be honest, science rules our lives and has helped us to accomplish wonders, and it’s given us knowledge untold. Yet, there are so many who still don’t hold to what science offers. Take for instance, how science has explained away many of the mysteries of the world, yet… so many of us are still of the belief that there are still things out there we cannot explain. Things science hasn’t uncovered for us. Such as ghosts, the ambiguity of aliens and so much more.
​
Which is backed up by viral videos and testimonials from people who swear they have had some kind of strange encounter in this life, and well, that’s enough to keep us believing and enough for a new show about such matters to come to life. For this October will see the debut of Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena on Sundance Now, AMC+, and All Reality, and it will indeed dive deep into such matters. Plus, to properly celebrate this news, AMC Global Media dropped a trailer and key art for the show which we will share with you now, so you can prepare to properly explore the great unknowns that still haunt us.

‘AMC Global Media today released the official trailer and key art for the riveting new 6-part docu-series Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena, premiering on Thursday, October 1 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV, AMC+ and All Reality, with new episodes premiering weekly on all platforms. Hosted by Professor Jeffrey J. Kripal, one of the leading scholars of extraordinary human experiences, Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.

 The stories told on Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena add to a trove already containing over one million pieces of evidence – collected for nearly a century – investigating telepathy, near-death experiences, UFO encounters, alien abductions, prophetic dreams, and messages from the beyond. Included in the series is work by Pulitzer Prize-winning Harvard psychiatrist Dr. John E. Mack and bestselling author Whitley Strieber. Together their accounts raise a larger question at the heart of Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena – what if these seemingly separate mysteries are not separate at all? 

EPISODE DESCRIPTIONS

 Episode 1 – "Telepathic Children" – Premieres Thursday, October 1 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV;
Available on AMC+ and All Reality
Two non-verbal autistic girls communicate telepathically with their mothers describing a realm called "The Hill." Rare footage reveals a pioneer who studied psychic children, challenging neuroscience and questioning consciousness and connection.

 Episode 2 – "Alien Abduction" – Premieres Thursday, October 8 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV;
Available on AMC+ and All Reality
Childhood encounters with mysterious beings, ancient prophecies, and messages from an unknown intelligence lead two experiencers to question humanity's future as the Archives reveal a Harvard psychiatrist who risked his career to study them.

 Episode 3 – "Dark Visions" – Premieres Thursday, October 15 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV;
Available on AMC+ and All Reality
Can some people glimpse the future? A man haunted by prophetic dreams and a remote viewer who solves crimes challenge our understanding of time as the Archives uncover secret government psychic research into precognition.

 Episode 4 – "Speaking with the Dead" – Premieres Thursday, October 22 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV;
Available on AMC+ and All Reality
A medium with a harrowing past helps solve murders while another psychic battles terrifying spiritual encounters. The Archives reveal a parapsychologist rethinking mediumship, raising a haunting question: what exists beyond the veil?

 Episode 5 – "Near Death Experience" – Premieres Thursday, October 29 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV;
Available on AMC+ and All Reality
After surviving death, two women return with uncanny abilities, from visions of future events to mind-over-matter phenomena. The Archives reveal a pattern: survivors return profoundly changed. Does consciousness survive death?

 Episode 6 – "Aliens & Demons" – Premieres Thursday, November 5 at 10pm ET/PT on SundanceTV;
Available on AMC+ and All Reality
Two women believe unseen forces are attacking their bodies and minds as experts confront demonic entities, alien intelligence, and spiritual warfare. The Archives uncover a Vatican exorcist who believed in UFOs, asking if they share the same mystery.

 Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena is developed for television by Harris Fishman and October Films Ltd and is executive produced by Chris Muckle, Fishman, Tom Thayer, Ellen Rocamora and Mike Warner, who also serves as showrunner. Charlotte Chalker and Dan Howlett are story producers. The series is directed by Amy Lee-Jones and co-directed by Fishman. Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena is edited by Ian Baignet (Episodes 1 and 6), Jonny Strachan (Episodes 1, 2 and 3), Mark Roberts (Episodes 3 and 6), Reva Childs (Episode 4), and Sam Billinge (Episodes 5 and 6).

About AMC Global Media
AMC Global Media (Nasdaq: AMCX) is home to many of the greatest stories and characters in TV and film and the premier destination for passionate and engaged fan communities around the world. The Company creates and curates celebrated series and films across distinct brands and makes them available to audiences everywhere. Its portfolio includes targeted streaming services AMC+, Acorn TV, Shudder, Sundance Now, ALLBLK, HIDIVE and All Reality; cable networks AMC, BBC AMERICA (which includes U.S. distribution and sales responsibilities for BBC News), IFC, SundanceTV and We TV; and film distribution label Independent Film Company. The Company also operates AMC Studios, its in-house studio, production and distribution operation behind acclaimed and fan-favorite original franchises including The Walking Dead Universe and the Anne Rice Immortal Universe. AMC Global Media is headquartered in the United States, with international operations in Iberia, Latin America, Central Europe, the U.K., Australia and New Zealand.'
